text:
Marco: Anyone else hit the long ferry line this morning? Took ~40 mins to actually board. Ferry ops said there was a weird 'surge' because of an event at the pier.
commute-bot: SF FERRY STATUS: Expect 30-45 minute boarding delays at Ferry Building & Pier 1. Operators on it. https://status.sfmta.gov
Jess: Wow that explains the crowd. I bailed and took 101 — stalled truck near 4th made that slow too.
Anya: I hopped on BART with my bike. Embarcadero had people handing out coffee like a pop-up tailgate? Not complaining. :coffee:
Oliver: Bike lane under 3rd was basically a river, chain soaked. Soggy sneakers forever. :sneezing_face:
Lina: I keep a spare pair of dry shoes in office 210 for just this reason. First-come-first-serve. :wink:
Marco: @Lina you are a hero. FYI saw Caltrans signs for 'high winds on bridge' around 7:15am.
Jess: Someone's hat got taken by wind on the Golden Gate walkway. Tragic. :crying_cat_face:
commute-bot: MUNI ALERT: 33 & 14 experiencing delays due to debris cleanup; F-line reduced service.
Anya: For anyone coming into the office: lower garage has puddles near the elevator. Bring a towel or park elsewhere.
Oliver: Photo: ```IMG_4211.jpg - wet chain + mud, will clean later```
Marco: Quick poll — spontaneous "soggy sneakers support group" at 11:30 in the cafe? React with :raised_hands: to join or :no_entry_sign: if you can't.
Jess: :raised_hands:
Anya: :raised_hands:
Lina: :thumbsup:
Oliver: :no_entry_sign: on a call but will swing by with spare tissues.
Marco: Cool. Tagging @commute-team so they can note the bridge wind sign and garage puddles.
commute-bot: INCIDENT LOGGED: Ferry surge / boarding delays — Ops acknowledged. ETA to normalize: 09:30 local.
Jess: Also FYI, cafe counter is running a small staff-run 2-for-1 coffee coupon for soggy commuters today. Very wholesome.
Marco: Alright team — see you at 11:30 if you're coming. Stay as dry as possible. :umbrella:
